method: AST scan for swallowed exceptions, regex scan for zero-for-missing / hardcoded season / direct draw loads / tie-break-by-file-order, plus dynamic probes of every model input for its latest ordinal, plus the defects measured and fixed in commits 4cbf04e / 18c920d / e880753

severity_definitions.P0: can corrupt a live forecast or DFS decision silently
severity_definitions.P1: can materially distort projections or the optimizer
severity_definitions.P2: important but bounded, or a manual workaround exists

honesty_note: P2-01 and P2-02 report MEASURED COUNTS of a pattern, not confirmed defects. Most instances are legitimate. They are logged so the triage is visible as outstanding rather than implied to be done.
